'''Short Dry Grass''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from [[Tall Dry Grass]]), a [[Kindling]] recipe (from [[Short Grass]] or [[Fern]]) and an [[Oven]] recipe (from [[Short Grass]] or [[Fern]]). See {{MCW|Short Dry Grass}} for everything else.
